explanation.why_it_matters: This change requires users to migrate to alternative models to avoid disruption to their workflows after the retirement date.
how_to_use: Migrate existing applications to use recommended replacement models before October 28, 2025
Update API requests to use non-deprecated models for new developments

items.title: The 1-hour cache duration for prompt caching is now generally available
items.summary: The 1-hour cache duration for prompt caching is now generally available. You can now use the extended cache TTL without a beta header. Learn more in Prompt caching.

explanation.what_it_is: The 1-hour cache duration for prompt caching allows Claude Code users to store prompt results for up to 1 hour, reducing the need for repeated computations. This feature is now available without requiring a beta header.
explanation.why_it_matters: With the 1-hour cache duration, users can optimize their workflows by minimizing redundant computations and improving overall performance. This is particularly useful for applications that require frequent reuse of prompt results.
how_to_use: Use the extended cache TTL to store prompt results for up to 1 hour, eliminating the need for a beta header
Optimize workflows by caching prompt results for repeated use cases, such as data processing or information retrieval
